item.title: Greenville Police report 12% decrease in crime rate for 2025
item.description: GREENVILLE, N.C. (WNCT) -- Greenville Chief of Police Richard Tyndall shared their 2025 Statistical Review with the City Council. According to the GPD, Greenville's overall crime rate decreased by 12% in 2025 compared to 2024, with property crime down 13% citywide.
